title: Prevention Among Young People With Intellectual Disability
brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate an intervention using the Toolkit "Children - what does it involve?" and the "Real-Care-Baby" (RCB) simulator among students with intellectual disability (ID), using a cluster randomized trial design with waiting-list control group.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Students with mild or moderate ID with informed consent can be included
* Understand and respond to a questionnaire

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Students with severe ID
